title: Cashiering Standard: Payments and Settlement of Guest Folios
content:
**Standard.** Money held for the reservation is applied to the Guest Folio at check-in as a deposit transfer payment line. At check-out, where the brand charges the remaining balance to the card on file automatically, the remaining balance is charged to the card on file as a card payment line and the folio is settled with the check-out date and time. A folio is settled only when its balance due is zero. A late charge posted to a settled folio is paid by a further card payment line on the card on file on the day it is posted. Payments are applied only to a folio whose status is open or settled. When the stay is credited to an Ashbury Rewards membership, settlement posts the stay's points under the Ashbury Rewards earning rules.

## Money movements on the folio

| Moment | Line | Effect on the balance due |
|---|---|---|
| Check-in, money held for the reservation | Deposit transfer payment | Lowers it |
| Check-out, automatic settlement to the card on file | Card payment for the remaining balance | Brings it to zero, then the folio is settled with the check-out date and time |
| Late charge posted after settlement | Further card payment on the card on file, on the day the late charge is posted | Brings it back to zero |

The balance due of a folio is what the guest owes on it: charges and refunds raise it; payments, adjustments and benefit credits lower it; a negative balance is a credit due to the guest.

## Conditions

- **Settlement** requires a balance due of zero, on the folio's own record.
- **Payments** are applied only while the folio is open or settled; a reopened folio takes no payment line.
- **Points** for a stay credited to an Ashbury Rewards membership are posted at settlement under the Ashbury Rewards earning rules.

## Worked sequence (hypothetical folio)

A folio opens with a deposit transfer of $150.00 against charges that reach $612.40 by check-out; the balance due is then $462.40, the card on file is charged $462.40 and the folio is settled with a balance of zero. Two days later a minibar charge of $18.00 incurred during the stay is posted to the settled folio; on that day a further card payment of $18.00 is applied, and the balance returns to zero.
